fact: The Universal Access Fund reports it installed Starlink in Vahun District, Lofa County, a project overseen on site by Commissioner Patrick R. Honnah; no cost is given and the document does not name the law that set up the fund or say how the project was paid for.

The Liberia Telecommunications Authority issued Regulations LTA-REG-0006 on 10 September 2015, under sections 22 and 23 of the Telecommunications Act 2007, creating the Universal Access Fund with a bank account and a board, and setting licensee contributions at 0.5 per cent of annual gross revenues for its first year; this is the creating regulation, with no collections or payments stated.
Budget tables: 731,376 USD is published as actually spent on digital lines for FY2025. Dated by the document that gives the figure.
Budget tables: the budget for FY2026 gives 12,464,422 USD to 14 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.
